EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A cold front moved through Massachusetts during the afternoon and evening of August 18th.  Showers and thunderstorms associated with this front left from one to three inches of rain in the state, with numerous reports of flooding.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: At 12:59 PM EST, Tapley Street near Oak Hill Cemetary was closed due to floodwaters three feet deep.  At 1:21 PM EST Fire Rescue was called to rescue people in trapped car on Tapley Street.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Low pressure moved east from the Great Lakes. This drew warm humid air north across Massachusetts, then swung a cold front across the state.  This caused afternoon thunderstorms; the most damaging thunderstorms moved across the northern half of Massachusetts.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: At 3:44 PM EST, street flooding reached a depth of two to three feet on Gorham Street in Lowell.
